title: Substrate structure and site response in rotaxane amination
difficulty_reasons: The complete substrate is a mechanically interlocked 123-atom molecular system whose identity and topology must be preserved.
The investigation connects structural evidence to comparative aryl-site susceptibility without a supplied explanatory route or computational recipe.
Indirect substrate properties require careful scientific judgment before they can explain catalytic enantioselectivity; uncertainty and model-condition limits are substantive.

paper.title: Catalytic enantioselective synthesis of mechanically planar chiral rotaxanes by organocatalyzed desymmetrization

data.description: Neutral graph-explicit substrate/reagent/product identities, experimental conditions and observed reaction context for the shared scientific question.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research status, hypotheses, investigations, evidence, conclusions, limitations and artifact index using the shared schema.
